title: Plan full MVP hardening tasks

context.summary: Split the remaining non-demo MVP gaps into explicit task files after the baseline MVP implementation was committed.
context.background: TASK-1 through TASK-27 are represented by the baseline commit. Live Docker acceptance passes, but several hardening areas remain before the MVP is ready beyond a local demo.

in: Create separate task files for auth operations, integration tests, live embeddings search, MCP packaging, Hermes runtime validation, production hardening and demo ergonomics.
Update tasks/tasks.json with the new task sequence.
Set the next implementation task as current_task_id.
Keep this task limited to task planning and process metadata.
out: Change runtime API, worker, MCP or Hermes behavior outside task metadata.

acceptance_criteria: TASK-29 through TASK-35 exist as separate task files.
Each new task has clear scope, acceptance criteria, verification commands, dependencies and risks.
current_task_id points at the next implementation task.

manual_checks: Confirm this branch started from master.
Confirm TASK-28 contains only task planning changes.
Confirm TASK-29 is the next actionable task.

risks: Planning too broadly can blur acceptance boundaries; each future task must remain independently mergeable.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
